PS1.title: Presentation Skills 1: Communication Defined
PS1.content: Overview of CommunicationThe term communication is derived from the Latin word 'communis', which means common. Beyond simple commonality, the concept incorporates transfer, meaning, and information.The Golden Rule: You cannot not communicate.Definition: The process through which two or more persons exchange ideas and mutual understanding.Core Aspects: Consists of transmission and understanding.

PS2.title: Presentation Skills 2: Effective Communication Skills and the 7 C's
PS2.content: Effective Communication and the 7 C'sEffective communication provides guidelines for influencing others and ensuring your message is understood. The framework relies on seven key principles:Completeness: Providing all necessary details to the audience.Conciseness: Sticking to the point using brief, impactful wording.Consideration: Focusing on the receiver's viewpoint, background, and needs.Concreteness: Using solid facts, specifics, and figures.Clarity: Choosing precise, easy-to-understand words.Courtesy: Maintaining politeness and mutual respect.Correctness: Ensuring exact facts, figures, and grammar.
